name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
briefDescription: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) is a renewable one-year life-insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for bank/post-office account holders aged 18–50, for a premium of ₹436 a year.
descriptionMd: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) is a low-cost life-insurance scheme that pays out on death due to **any cause**. It is a one-year term cover that renews every year, offered through participating banks and post offices and backed by life-insurance companies. Any account holder of a participating bank or post office aged **18 to 50** can join.
benefitsMd:
- **Life cover of ₹2 lakh** for one year, payable to your nominee on death due to **any reason**.
- The cover renews from year to year.
- The premium is just **₹436 per year** per member, auto-debited from your bank or post-office account.
eligibilityMd:
- You must be **between 18 and 50 years old**.
- You must hold an **individual bank or post-office account** and agree to the annual auto-debit of the premium.
applicationMd:
PMJJBY is enrolled offline through your bank or post office:

**Step 1:** Download and print the **Consent-cum-Declaration form** from the official Jansuraksha portal.
**Step 2:** Fill in and sign the form, attach self-attested copies of the required documents, and submit it to the authorised official at your bank or post office.
**Step 3:** The official will hand you the **Acknowledgement Slip Cum Certificate of Insurance** as proof of cover.
